entities.summary: Bruno Valfrid Ahlberg was a Finnish boxer who competed in the 1932 and 1936 Summer Olympics. In 1932, he became the first Finnish boxer to win an Olympic medal, a bronze in the welterweight division. Four years later he lost his first bout in the middleweight competition.
